map.ROT1-ROT25 字母移位，含 ROT13 / ROT47 / ROT5 /: ROT1–ROT25 letter shifts, including ROT13 / ROT47 / ROT5 / ROT18.
map.ROT 系列轮换密码（凯撒密码的特例）。: The ROT family of rotation ciphers (a special case of the Caesar cipher).
map.：把字母按固定位数平移，如 ROT13 平移 13 位。: : Shift letters by a fixed amount, e.g. ROT13 shifts by 13.
map.：26 个字母下平移 13 位两次即还原，故 ROT13 加密与解密是同一操作。: : Under 26 letters, shifting 13 twice returns to the original, so ROT13's encrypt and decrypt are the same operation.
map.：通常只作用于字母，数字与标点符号保持不变。: : Usually only affects letters; digits and punctuation stay unchanged.
map.：无密钥安全性，仅用于简单混淆（如隐藏剧透、答案）。: : No key-based security; only for simple obfuscation (e.g. hiding spoilers, answers).
map.: 字母移动 13 位，两次应用还原，最常用: : Letters shift 13; two applications restore; the most common
map.: 字母移动指定位数: : Letters shift by a specified amount
map.ROT13 用于论坛隐藏剧透，ROT47 覆盖更多可打印字符。: ROT13 hides spoilers on forums; ROT47 covers more printable characters.
map.论坛隐藏剧透或答案：用 ROT13 处理后再发布，读者点击展开时再转回来，避免内: Hide spoilers or answers on forums: process with ROT13 before posting; readers convert back when they click to expand, avoiding the content being seen at a glance.
map.输入 `HELLO` → 输出 `URYYB`（ROT13 自反，再转一次还原）: Input `HELLO` → output `URYYB` (ROT13 is self-inverse; convert again to restore).
map.不是，只是混淆，任何人都能还原。: No, it's only obfuscation; anyone can reverse it.
map.ROT47 和 ROT13 有什么区别？: What's the difference between ROT47 and ROT13?
map.ROT13 只在 26 个字母内移位，会跳过数字与符号；ROT47 在 33–1: ROT13 shifts only within the 26 letters, skipping digits and symbols; ROT47 shifts 47 within the 94 printable ASCII characters (33–126), so digits and punctuation are also transformed, making the output less readable and harder to recognize at a glance. Both are keyless fixed transforms, used only for obscuring, providing no confidentiality.
map.ROT 全套。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，代码不离开浏览器。: ROT suite. An online tool built for developers, runs entirely in the browser; your code never leaves the device.
